subject: general
question: Find the surface area of the cuboid with dimensions 3 cm, 5 cm and 8 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula for **Surface Area**: 2 × (lb + bh + lh)

Surface Area = 2 × (3 × 5 + 5 × 8 + 8 × 3)

Surface Area = 2 × (15 + 40 + 24) = 2 × 79

**∴ The correct answer is 158 square cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (l) = 3 cm

Breadth (b) = 5 cm

Height (h) = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of **Cuboid** = 2(lb + bh + hl)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dded9786d5db344a0d9fdf9f952d66493fe78d9acfb70ce9b610909e7eb4bcc4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × [(3 × 5) + (5 × 8) + (8 × 3)]

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × [15 + 40 + 24]

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × [79]

⇒ Surface Area = 158 square cm

**∴ The correct answer is 158 square cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Volume = Length × Breadth × Height (l × b × h).

Lateral Surface Area

The area of the four side faces (excluding top and bottom) is given by LSA = 2h(l + b).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed in a cuboid has length = √(l² + b² + h²).</p
